_comment: Shrink-only baseline for tests/ability-fire/ability-fire-coverage.test.ts (CR audit tool 1.18). Recorded 2026-11-20: the CR 9.3 ability records on supported cards that no seeded playout fires, by the area they are filed under (tests/ability-fire/abilities.ts). Each area's evidence step reads its list and adds a hand-built test for each; tests/generated/ability-fire-coverage.json says which already have one. An ability leaves the list when a playout fires it. Regenerate with npx tsx scripts/update-ability-fire.ts.
